description: This file defines a React functional component 'AgentSelector' that provides a multi-select UI for choosing agents and access groups. It fetches agent data from an external API, structures options with visual indicators, and manages selection state. It facilitates selecting agents and groups separately within a broader UI context.

methods.name: AgentSelector
methods.description: React functional component that renders a multi-select dropdown to choose agents and access groups, fetching data on mount and updating parent component on change.
